China warns Britain not to smear it. This comes a day after a report said Beijing was mulling, carrying out AI operations against the UK's critical infrastructure. Countries like Britain, the U.S. and New Zealand have publicly accused China of cyber breaches over the last decade. But Beijing has vehemently denied these claims. Hem Kaur Saroya explains tonight on Vantage.
